shortDescription: Create, update or destroy a volume.

options.name: allow_replace
options.description: Boolean indicating if the resource should be recreated when the state cannot be reached in another way. This may be used to prevent resources from being deleted from specifying a different value to an immutable property. An error will be thrown instead

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: The availability zone in which the volume should be provisioned. The storage volume will be provisioned on as few physical storage devices as possible, but this cannot be guaranteed upfront. This is uavailable for DAS (Direct Attached Storage), and subject to availability for SSD.

options.name: backupunit
options.description: The ID of the backup unit that the user has access to. The property is immutable and is only allowed to be set on creation of a new a volume. It is mandatory to provide either 'public image' or 'imageAlias' in conjunction with this property.

options.name: bus
options.description: The bus type for this volume; default is VIRTIO.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of volumes you wish to create.

options.name: cpu_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable CPU (no reboot required).

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The datacenter in which to create the volumes.

options.name: disc_virtio_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable Virt-IO drive (no reboot required).

options.name: disc_virtio_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable Virt-IO drive (no reboot required). Not supported with Windows VMs.

options.name: disk_type
options.description: The disk type of the volume.

options.name: image
options.description: Image or snapshot ID to be used as template for this volume. MSSQL Enterprise Images can be used only if the feature toggle for MSSQL Enterprise is enabled on the contract.

options.name: image_password
options.description: Initial password to be set for installed OS. Works with public images only. Not modifiable, forbidden in update requests. Password rules allows all characters from a-z, A-Z, 0-9.

options.name: instance_ids
options.description: list of instance ids or names. Should only contain one ID if renaming in update state

options.name: licence_type
options.description: OS type for this volume.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the  resource.

options.name: nic_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable NIC (no reboot required).

options.name: nic_hot_unplug
options.description: Hot-unplug capable NIC (no reboot required).

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: ram_hot_plug
options.description: Hot-plug capable RAM (no reboot required).

options.name: server
options.description: The server to which to attach the volume.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the volume in GB.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: Public SSH keys are set on the image as authorized keys for appropriate SSH login to the instance using the corresponding private key. This field may only be set in creation requests. When reading, it always returns null. SSH keys are only supported if a public Linux image is used for the volume creation.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: user_data
options.description: The cloud-init configuration for the volume as base64 encoded string. The property is immutable and is only allowed to be set on creation of a new a volume. It is mandatory to provide either 'public image' or 'imageAlias' that has cloud-init compatibility in conjunction with this property.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
